table.name: TLGNR_SHIPPPOINT_TYPE_BS
table.description: Reference data table for the types of Shipping Points, e.g. Road, Rail, Container Terminal etc. The shippingpoint type what kind of vehicles can be loaded there. 1) A Road SP can load trucks, trailers and containers as long as they are on a truck/trailer. 2) A Rail SP can load wagons and containers when they are on the wagon. 3) A Container Terminal Truck can load a full container on a truck, with the help of a cran or huge forklift (container reachstacker). 4, 5, 6) Rail shippingpoints at the Supplier, Repair plant or other External places are not used to actually load a rail, but only needed as a starting point of inbound and return rail orders. 7) A Container Terminal Rail is a shippingpoint where a full container is loaded on a wagon (with a cran or container reachstacker).

column.name: SHIPPPOINT_TYPE_CD
column.description: PK. Code of the Reference Data. 0=Road, 1=Rail, 2=Container Terminal (Truck), 3=Bimodal Truck (Freiverlad), 4=Rail Supplier, 5=Rail Repair, 6=Rail External/just Return. 7=Container Terminal (Rail).

column.name: IS_RAIL_FLAG
column.description: Defines if it is a rail shippingpoint. For rail shippingpoints, the definition of a railway_station is mandatory.

column.name: CTL_ACT_CD
column.description: Active Flag. When new data is entered, only reference data with active flag are available for selection normally.
